One cat-shaped economy on top of GregTech: coins, rings, a vending machine that also signs you in, runs lotteries and delivers mail.

Forty-five quests in four chapters: Neko Coin basics, Shimmering Coins and the eight rings, advanced lottery play, and shop administration with a peek at the trade group API.

Everything runs from the Neko Vending Machine multiblock.
